-- Clean expired holders
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', key, 0, now)

-- Check capacity
local count = redis.call('ZCARD', key)
if count >= max then
  return 0
end

-- Add holder with expiry as score
redis.call('ZADD', key, now + ttl_ms, holder)
redis.call('PEXPIRE', key, ttl_ms)
return 1
`;
